description:
Looking to leave practice or for an engaging opportunity to apply your legal expertise in a cutting-edge legal tech environment? Trellis is looking for attorneys for a contract position. Join a leading provider of unparalleled trial court insights and be part of a team that's revolutionizing how attorneys access and leverage trial court data.
 
Who We Are
Trellis is a legal data and AI startup that surfaces powerful insights and makes the US trial courts searchable, with an emphasis on fixing the fragmented state trial court system (largest court system in the world). We provide trial court data, as well as insights such as judicial, law firm, venue, attorneys, analytics. Trellis is a Series B venture-backed legal tech startup backed by some of the best investors and venture capital firms in the world.  The company has grown massively since launching in 2018 and is already serving many of the largest law firms and corporate legal departments in the nation. Trellis is at the forefront of the data, AI and technology transformation taking place in legal.  It is an incredibly exciting time to join us.
 
The Role
As a Document Review / Verdict Classification Attorney, you will play a pivotal role in enhancing our AI-driven legal intelligence platform. This position involves reviewing and analyzing civil court documents to determine case outcomes, classifying verdict details, and labeling key data such as dollar amounts awarded. Your contributions will directly impact the quality and accuracy of our platform and help provide massive value to our users.

What You'll Do:

  • Reviewing and analyzing civil court documents to classify case outcomes.
  • Identifying and labeling case details, including verdict types and monetary awards.
  • Using custom, web-based software to ensure data accuracy.
  • Providing feedback on software functionality to enhance user experience.
    •  

    Project Details

  • Hours: 20 - 40 hours per week
  • Pay: $20-30/hr
  • Location: Fully remote
  • Duration: 3-6+ month contract
    •  

    Who You Are:

  • JD from an accredited law school, active Illinois licensure strongly preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain high-quality work under deadlines.
  • Proficiency in reviewing civil court filings; experience with state court filings is a plus.
    •  
     
    At Trellis, we value innovation, collaboration, and inclusion. Whether you're an experienced document reviewer or a JD eager to expand your legal tech experience, we encourage you to apply and grow with us.
